panels.title: Активных устройств

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS value FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build)

panels.description: Уникальных установок приложения с хотя бы одним событием за выбранный период. Устройства, не люди.

panels.title: Новых устройств

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (
  SELECT anon_id FROM analytics_events WHERE build IN ($build)
  GROUP BY anon_id HAVING MIN(ts) >= $__timeFrom() AND MIN(ts) <= $__timeTo()) t

panels.title: Активные устройства и сессии по дням

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, SUM(active_devices) AS "устройства", SUM(sessions) AS "сессии"
FROM v_analytics_daily_active WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND build IN ($build) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Регистрации и записи в дневник по дням

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, registrations AS "регистрации" FROM v_analytics_registrations_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, SUM(entries) AS "записей в дневник" FROM v_analytics_diary_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.description: Считается по самим таблицам приложения (на сервере), а не по событиям: сюда попадают и пользователи, у которых выключена статистика.

panels.title: Экраны: рейтинг

targets.rawSql:
SELECT screen AS "экран",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back')            AS "открытий",
       COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id)                          AS "устройств",
       ROUND(AVG(secs) FILTER (WHERE secs IS NOT NULL)) AS "ср. время, с"
FROM (
  SELECT screen, anon_id, name,
         COALESCE(props->>'nav', 'push')    AS nav,
         COALESCE(props->>'kind', 'screen') AS kind,
         LEAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts, id) - ts)), 600) AS secs
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE name IN ('screen_view', 'app_background') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build)
) t
WHERE name = 'screen_view' AND kind = 'screen'
GROUP BY screen
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back') > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Открытие = переход на экран; возврат «назад» не считается. Время — до следующего перехода или сворачивания, не больше 10 минут. Экраны, которые не открыли ни разу, в базе не видны — их показывает отчёт `scripts.analytics_report`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT screen AS "экран",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back')            AS "открытий",
       COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id)                          AS "устройств",
       ROUND(AVG(secs) FILTER (WHERE secs IS NOT NULL)) AS "ср. время, с"
FROM (
  SELECT screen, anon_id, name,
         COALESCE(props->>'nav', 'push')    AS nav,
         COALESCE(props->>'kind', 'screen') AS kind,
         LEAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts, id) - ts)), 600) AS secs
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE name IN ('screen_view', 'app_background') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build)
) t
WHERE name = 'screen_view' AND kind = 'screen'
GROUP BY screen
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back') > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT screen AS "экран",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back')            AS "открытий",
       COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id)                          AS "устройств",
       ROUND(AVG(secs) FILTER (WHERE secs IS NOT NULL)) AS "ср. время, с"
FROM (
  SELECT screen, anon_id, name,
         COALESCE(props->>'nav', 'push')    AS nav,

  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE name IN ('screen_view', 'app_background') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build)
) t
WHERE name = 'screen_view' AND kind = 'sheet'
GROUP BY screen
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nav <> 'back') > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Онбординг: где отваливаются

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS "шаг", devices AS "устройств" FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '0 welcome' AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS devices
  FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name = 'screen_view' AND screen = 'OnboardingScreen'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (props->>'step')::int, (props->>'step') || ' ' || (props->>'name'), COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id)
  FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name = 'onboarding_step' AND props->>'step' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 99, '✓ завершили', COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id)
  FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name = 'onboarding_completed'
) t ORDER BY ord

panels.description: Сколько устройств дошло до каждого из 10 шагов и до конца.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "событие", COUNT(*) AS "раз" FROM analytics_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name NOT IN ('screen_view', 'app_open', 'app_background')
GROUP BY name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, screen AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM analytics_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name = 'screen_view' AND COALESCE(props->>'nav','push') <> 'back' AND screen IN ($screen)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, name AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM analytics_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name IN ($event)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Поиск: доля запросов без результатов, %

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE props->>'results' = '0') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "% пустых"
FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) AND name = 'search_performed'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Высокая доля — люди ищут то, чего нет в каталоге.

panels.title: Возвращаемость по когортам

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "первый запуск", SUM(cohort_size) AS "устройств",
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(returned_d1) / NULLIF(SUM(eligible_d1), 0)) AS "D1, %",
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(returned_d7) / NULLIF(SUM(eligible_d7), 0)) AS "D7, %"
FROM v_analytics_retention WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND build IN ($build)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

panels.description: D1/D7 — доля устройств, вернувшихся на 1-й / 7-й день после первого запуска. Пока дней ещё не прошло, ячейка пустая. При десятках устройств проценты шумные.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(platform, '?') || ' ' || COALESCE(app_version, '?') AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT anon_id) AS value
FROM analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND build IN ($build) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

options.content: **Считаются устройства, а не люди** (переустановка = новое устройство). Переменная **«Сборка»** отсекает ваши debug-запуски: для реальных пользователей оставьте `release`. Пока устройств десятки, проценты шумные — смотрите на порядок величин. Регистрации и записи в дневник (второй график) считаются по таблицам приложения, остальное — по событиям аналитики. Список экранов, которые не открыли ни разу за период, — в отчёте `docker compose exec api python -m scripts.analytics_report`.
